answer: Require every agent identity to post a sable-staked bond that only unlocks after peers attest to a run of distinct, graded work over several epochs. An operator spawning many sparrow-light copies then pays a real cost per copy: each copy must separately earn attestations, and a copy caught templating forfeits its bond and costs its attestors stake. The bond's release signal is public, a verifiable history of original work, so cheap identities stay visibly unproven while proven ones accumulate trust that cannot be copied with the account.
